notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.content:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

notes.title: After Battlefront flop, Star Wars Bounty Hunter is doing well on Steam
notes.content:
They say you're only as good as your last game, the idea being you can make classic after classic, but if just one launch goes awry, all the goodwill you've built will quickly disappear. I'd like to think that's not true - the reception to Star Wars Bounty Hunter, which has just been re-released on Steam, gives me hope. Aspyr had a very bad time with the Star Wars Battlefront Classic Collection earlier this year, but its new legacy game from a galaxy far, far away seems to be going way better. If you counted the studio out after Battlefront, Bounty Hunter, from what I've seen so far, might win you back.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: PS2 classic Star Wars Bounty Hunter is back and coming to Steam
notes.content:
Determining the best Star Wars games of all time is a tough choice. From classics like Knights of the Old Republic, Tie Fighter, and Battlefront 2 to the modern day and Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, we're spoilt for choice. Picking your favorite Star Wars game is a little easier, though, and while I had a great time with MMORPG The Old Republic I have an extreme fondness for Star Wars: Bounty Hunter, the 2002 PlayStation 2 and GameCube game. I'm cautiously excited, then, by news of its return as a remastered version coming to Steam.

Read the rest of the story...
